title: Customer agreement and follow-up email communication
summary: This topic centers on brief service interactions where customers agreed with the advisor or the writer promised follow-up by email, with most fragments too limited to show a clear outcome.

positive.summary: Positive reviews describe customer agreement with the proposed next step and a writer offering to investigate or send more information by email.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews are short acknowledgments of customer agreement or writer follow-up that lack enough context to judge the experience.

limitations: Most fragments are very short and do not provide enough context to determine satisfaction or the final outcome.
The topic is narrowly about communication phrases such as agreement, advice, and email follow-up rather than a single vehicle issue.
Samples are stratified and not representative estimates of the full topic or ownership experience.
